events.description: Something is taken down where it happened — abstract, typed by nothing yet
The artefact learns what it is — a shot, a motif, a note, a testimony; the vocabulary stays open, never an enum
Legible at last — the artefact can be read, though not yet told
The yes was spoken in pre-production, by people who were actually in the room, before anything was carried onto the land — this artefact enters the memory carrying that yes, not seeking one
Someone is in this whom pre-production never covered — an Elder who spoke on the land, a voice a contributor brought, a stranger who forked the work
A named person said yes at a named threshold, and was in the room to say it
Withheld for now, or never asked — both of them wait
Someone who was in the room said no — an answer, not a pause
The one who had to be asked has answered — the threshold is approached again, never around
A flag raised on any artefact below holds the work above it — restriction climbs where permission never does
The hold lifts — the finished work returns to the publication threshold intact
Cleared to be seen at this scale — a page, a screening room, or a live room with people breathing in it
Someone with standing said it may never be seen — the record keeps the no rather than forgetting it
Another episode takes its number — the memory lengthens
The maker sets the work down where others can find it, before anyone has asked — generosity is unasked by definition
Carried to another room, another circle — the offering repeats and stays itself
Someone outside the work asks a question, or names a requirement they carry
The same question arrives again, from someone else — recurrence is the evidence; a single asking never was
An episode already held the answer — the question is met without a book, and that is a good outcome
The inquiry turns outward — the context so far, and what a part of it could be, laid open to someone who might make it
Another pair of hands answers the opening — the circle widens and stays itself
A human contributor opens their own surface — their work enters by the same door as everything else and meets the same gates
The opening met silence — the inquiry keeps its standing and waits
The circle asks the agents for parts — on request, never unbidden
Taken apart and put back changed — the hand that revises it is the one that will answer for it
A person picks it up and it becomes material — chosen, which is not what generated means
Nothing here is worth taking, and saying so leaves no one waiting
A need has been shown rather than merely felt — now there is a reason for covers
The question asks to be seen and not only read — now there is a reason for a film
Chapters set and bound — the manuscript is finished, which is not the same as permitted
Scenes hang on the spine in story order
Rough cut complete with temp sound — ready to screen
Director/producers request editorial changes — back to the bench
Picture lock — no further editorial changes
Color grade approved shot by shot
Key, tempo, sections and chords set against picture — the music is ready to be mixed
Final mix joins the rest — every hand's work onto one timeline
The conform passes technical quality control — the machine is satisfied, which settles nothing relational
QC found a picture defect — regrade required
QC found an audio defect — remix required
QC found the score wrong against picture — rewrite required
The screening room is not enough — the work needs to be carried onto the land
What presence on the land taught returns as a new gathering, not as a note
Someone presses play, opens the cover, or takes a seat — the work finds an audience
The listener moves on — the work advances, the story holds
A listener leaves the master line to author their own narrative — a new telling, at a new scale
The same knowledge visits again on another turn of the wheel — not new, deepening. It is asking to be made into a more evolved form
The question has more than one honest answer and the reader should choose — the chronicle turns toward an interactive telling
Another passage forks off — the story widens without leaving itself
The branches hold together as one traversable telling — finished, which is not the same as permitted

states.name: Gathering
states.description: SOUTH · Zhaawanong, land-based learning. Wherever you are — a mobile surface open where the knowledge lives: voice, image, video, a MIDI take, a note. The device is incidental; being present is the point. Whose hands are on it is not fixed either

transitions.description: Taken down on the spot — held before it is named

states.name: Artefact
states.description: SOUTH · The abstract type, carrying its provenance from birth — sources, authorityFlags, and a consent list. Promotion forks on one question, and it is no longer whether anyone else is here, but whether anyone is here whom pre-production never covered

transitions.description: INTERNAL — the artefact acquires a kind and stays itself
INTERNAL — legible now, and still not told
BRANCH — the ordinary production path; the yes is upstream and this artefact carries it
BRANCH — someone pre-production never spoke for is in this, so they decide
INTERNAL — knowledge visits across cycles of the wheel; promotion waits for the form to ripen, not for the capture to finish

states.name: ProposalBench
states.description: EAST→SOUTH · Agents lay out narrative parts and melodies against the context they were given. Nothing here has been anywhere. The work is to read it, revise it, and take what is worth taking — being generated is not being chosen

transitions.description: INTERNAL — a hand goes through it; the bench keeps working
Taken up by a person — it enters as material, never as presence; it was never on the land
LOOP — nothing worth taking; the circle keeps looking and nobody is left waiting

states.name: ConsentGate
states.description: WEST · Epangishmok, the talking circle. Not a toll on the production path — a threshold for the voices pre-production could not speak for. Do they consent to THIS telling, at THIS scale? A named person answers; nothing generated here may answer on their behalf

transitions.description: Yes, from someone who was in the room — the artefact may take a number
BRANCH — withheld for now, or never asked; both of them wait
BRANCH — a no that is an answer, not a delay

states.name: Held
states.description: WEST · Paused and routed to a named human — the work is not lost and not refused, it is waiting to be asked. Readiness cannot be rushed. Nothing ships while this holds

transitions.description: LOOP — the answer comes back to the threshold, never around it
LOOP — a hold raised at publication returns there, with the finished work intact

states.name: Withheld
states.description: WEST · Someone with standing said no. The telling ends here, and the record keeps the no rather than forgetting it

states.name: Chronicle
states.description: NORTH · Kiiwedinong, story archiving. Internal episodic memory — observations, research questions, subjects being explored, each taking its number and its place. This is the maker's own room; it lengthens on its own, and it turns toward nothing on its own

transitions.description: INTERNAL — the chronicle grows by one episode and stays itself
NORTH→EAST — the wheel turns; someone outside carries a question the work might answer

states.name: CommunityInquiry
states.description: EAST · Waabinong, new beginnings and vision. A question or requirement arrives from the community. One asking is a conversation; the same question arriving again is a need. An inquiry faces two ways: it asks something of the work, and it is the first moment the work has something to offer back

transitions.description: INTERNAL — the same question returns from someone else; the inquiry deepens and stays itself
BRANCH — the inquiry turns outward; the context is laid open to whoever might make a part of it
BRANCH — the need is shown; there is now a reason for covers
BRANCH — the need asks to be seen and not only read; the film answers a question too
LOOP — an episode already held the answer; nothing is made, and nothing is lost
BRANCH — the need has more than one answer; the reader is given the choosing

states.name: ContributorCircle
states.description: EAST · Co-authorship and decision-making authority. The context so far is visible to someone who is not the maker — a composer, a writer, a pair of hands the work needs. They see what has been done and what a part of it could be, and they decide for themselves whether to make it. Being shown is not being asked to serve

transitions.description: INTERNAL — another pair of hands answers; the circle widens and stays itself
The contributor opens their own surface — no side door; their work enters where everything else does
BRANCH — the circle asks the agents for parts; they are asked, they do not volunteer
LOOP — the opening met silence; the question keeps its standing and waits

states.name: Manuscript
states.description: SOUTH · Episodes gathered into chapters against a question that would not go away — the chronicle takes the shape of a book because someone needed one, and it may carry more hands than the maker's

transitions.description: Bound and finished — now it must still be permitted

states.name: StorySpine
states.description: SOUTH · The thematic spine every rib attaches to and every fork branches from — scenes laid in story order

transitions.description: Spine holds — refine into a full cut

states.name: RoughCut
states.description: SOUTH · Full-length cut with temp sound and placeholder VFX

transitions.description: Cut screens for director and producers

states.name: Review
states.description: WEST · A talking circle around the cut — director and producers screen it, and the verdict branches here

transitions.description: LOOP — notes go back to the spine
BRANCH — picture lock, finishing begins
The verdict is neither approve nor revise — the work goes to the land first

states.name: ColorGrade
states.description: SOUTH · Picture-locked footage graded shot by shot

transitions.description: Graded picture hands off to the songwriting bench

states.name: MusicalComposition
states.description: SOUTH · Music written to picture — key, capo, tempo, sections and chords; the same mobile surface as Gathering, whosever hands are on it. The composer may be the maker, and may well not be

transitions.description: Cues written against picture — the score hands off to the mix stage

states.name: SoundMix
states.description: SOUTH · Dialogue, score and effects mixed against the graded picture

transitions.description: Final mix joins the rest — every hand's work onto one timeline

states.name: Conform
states.description: SOUTH→WEST · Every contributor's work brought into agreement — grade, score, mix, and whatever else the circle made, conformed into one deliverable. Nobody masters it; the parts are made to agree. The technical gate, and only the technical one

transitions.description: QC clean — the machine is satisfied; the circle has not been asked
BRANCH — picture defect routes back to the grade
BRANCH — a cue wrong against picture routes back to whoever wrote it
BRANCH — audio defect routes back to the mix

states.name: PublicationGate
states.description: WEST→NORTH · The second threshold — not is it finished, but may it be seen, and at what scale: a page, a screening room, a live room with people breathing in it. Everything that stayed private needed no one's permission; leaving the room is where that stops being true, and everyone whose hands are in it has standing here

transitions.description: Cleared to be seen at this scale, by someone with the standing to say so
BRANCH — a flag on any artefact below holds the finished work above it
BRANCH — never, not merely not yet

states.name: Released
states.description: NORTH · Generosity. Delivered — as a book, as a film, as a room where it is performed live. No longer an ending, but a door

transitions.description: The maker carries it out before anyone asks
ENTRY — someone arrives on their own and the traversal begins

states.name: Offering
states.description: NORTH · Knowledge sharing, and the only place the maker can move the work alone. Released waits to be found; an offering is carried — set down in a room, a circle, a feed, unasked. This is where generosity lives, and it is the turn toward EAST

transitions.description: INTERNAL — carried to another room, another circle; the offering repeats and stays itself
Someone takes it up — what was offered is now being met
NORTH→EAST — the offering is answered with a question; the wheel turns

states.name: Playback
states.description: NORTH · Wisdom shared through story. The audience is inside the work — listening, reading, watching, moving through it in time

transitions.description: INTERNAL — the work advances, the story holds its shape
NORTH→EAST — the audience becomes the community; what they met leaves them with a question
FORK — a fork carries voices pre-production never spoke for, so it always meets the threshold

states.name: OnTheLand
states.description: SOUTH, and arguably EAST · The circle goes on the land — knowledge received through presence, place, and relations, not through the screen. Which direction owns this is genuinely unsettled: south holds land-based observation, east holds the vision quest

transitions.description: LOOP — the land's teaching re-enters as a new gathering and earns its own artefact

states.name: PassageWeave
states.description: SOUTH · Episodes woven into passages that branch — a Twine telling, a book that asks the reader which way. The third form the chronicle can take, and the one the forking was always pointing at: here a reader's choice is structure, not deviation

transitions.description: INTERNAL — another passage forks off; the weave widens and stays itself
Woven and traversable — now it must still be permitted
